trust_boundaries.name: Browser to application service
trust_boundaries.rule: Treat all IDs, headers, filters, claimed roles and DTO fields as untrusted; validate session proof at the service. Browser authentication does not prove a PostgreSQL login.

trust_boundaries.name: Service to PostgreSQL
trust_boundaries.rule: Lease a genuine nonadmin LOGIN connection for the exact authenticated subject; retain immutable session_user mapping, current privilege checks, RLS and transaction cleanup.

trust_boundaries.name: Application to media objects
trust_boundaries.rule: Resolve only authorized metadata, then operation-specific source and asset rights; private object keys and hashes are not bearer grants.

trust_boundaries.name: Intake to reviewed canonical selection
trust_boundaries.rule: Acquisition, raw claims, normalization proposals, review decisions, selected fields and eligibility remain independent gated records.

trust_boundaries.name: Private operational data to browser/storage/audit
trust_boundaries.rule: Project only authorized fields; no persistent operational browser/shared caches, secrets, private payload logs or cross-principal state reuse.

authorization_gates.name: Authenticate and validate request
authorization_gates.requires: Validated server-side session proof; exact DTO schema and explicit operation; no browser identity override.

authorization_gates.name: Lease genuine principal
authorization_gates.requires: Exact subject-to-LOGIN server binding, session_user=current_user, nonadmin effective privileges, fresh transaction, immutable subject/scope ownership.

authorization_gates.name: Authorize object and field scope
authorization_gates.before: Restricted lookup, counts, pagination, aggregates or source details
authorization_gates.requires: Current ownership/shared membership and allowed field/source provenance; public entity visibility does not publish private related records.

authorization_gates.name: Recheck source/asset operation rights
authorization_gates.before: Use, render or read/deliver bytes and after long processing
authorization_gates.requires: Current grant, purpose/audience/action, evidence binding, review deadline, revocation and full derivative lineage; unknown denies.

authorization_gates.name: Validate matching eligibility and partition
authorization_gates.requires: Authorized selected observations, policy/version compatibility, completeness, no conflict/hold, accepted real-data contract; synthetic remains separate.

authorization_gates.name: Authorize private/reviewer mutation
authorization_gates.requires: Exact object/action permission, replay/version protection and separate approved task; no generic admin browser endpoint.

authorization_gates.name: Project safe response and ephemeral state
authorization_gates.before: Response, error, log or UI update
authorization_gates.requires: Final authorization/rights check, uniform private unavailable result, no restricted IDs/counts/paths, no-store operational response and redacted audit.

authorization_gates.name: Revoke and release
authorization_gates.before: Reuse, logout, expiry or cancellation completion
authorization_gates.requires: Abort/rollback request, invalidate session and in-flight publication, clear UI buffers, discard suspect connections, verify fresh lease; no cross-principal reuse.

cache_operations.data: Content-hashed UI code, styles and generic icons only
cache_operations.allowed_location: Ordinary browser HTTP cache only for independently approved immutable public shell files
cache_operations.cache_key: Build/content hash + resource variant; no user or catalogue payload
cache_operations.lifetime: Content identity/build lifecycle; numeric TTL not selected
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Stop future fetch and remove managed copies where possible; already delivered assets cannot be recalled
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Previously cached generic shell may render; every operational feature remains Offline/Unavailable
cache_operations.security_risk: Embedding private initial state or licensed catalogue/media in a shell bypasses policy

cache_operations.data: Catalogue fields proven public for this exact projection
cache_operations.allowed_location: Request memory and current authorized render only; HTTP no-store
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + public projection + source/selection/rights versions
cache_operations.scope_binding: Exact public fields and purpose, after current rights checks
cache_operations.lifetime: Current request/render only; no numeric TTL
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Recheck before every operation; discard pending projection and best-effort clear render
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Unavailable offline; public entity scope alone does not allow retained source data
cache_operations.security_risk: Public perfume identity can be combined with private source fields or unsupported cache permission

cache_operations.data: Private notes, annotations, wishlist/research/app_cart/tried/skipped states and user overlays
cache_operations.allowed_location: Request memory and current principal-bound render only; HTTP no-store
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + exact principal/scope + membership/rights/projection versions
cache_operations.scope_binding: One verified principal and authorized scope/action
cache_operations.lifetime: Current request/render only; no numeric TTL
cache_operations.invalidation_trigger: Logout, expiry, principal/scope/membership/rights or overlay version change
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Deny next operation; clear render and request buffers; cancel stale response publication
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Unavailable offline; no local history or deferred replay
cache_operations.security_risk: Cross-user overlays leaked by shared response keys, SSR data or browser persistence

cache_operations.data: Queries, candidate projections, exact rational results and explanations
cache_operations.allowed_location: Request memory and current authorized render only; HTTP no-store; no query history
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + principal/scope + exact query, partition, dataset/selection, vocabulary, normalization, method/config and rights versions
cache_operations.scope_binding: One authorized request and compatible partition; no cross-user deduplication
cache_operations.lifetime: Current request/render only; no numeric TTL
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Recheck before candidate use/scoring and publication; discard stale results
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Unavailable offline; no stale score fallback or synthesized 0%
cache_operations.security_risk: A score, rank, candidate count or explanation can disclose restricted evidence

cache_operations.data: Seller links, recorded listing prices, manual Ordered bookmark stamps and separate owner-private manual purchase-history records with optional paid price, volume, date and seller
cache_operations.allowed_location: Request memory and current authorized render only; HTTP no-store
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + principal/scope + listing/status/purchase-record and rights versions
cache_operations.scope_binding: Caller-owned/authorized listing and purchase-history records; Cart remains a bookmark list
cache_operations.lifetime: Current request/render only; no numeric TTL
cache_operations.invalidation_trigger: Listing, permission, status, purchase-record, principal or scope change and logout
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Clear render; deny revoked links/details; no automatic external-cart action
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Unavailable offline; no queued orders or status/history writes
cache_operations.security_risk: Private seller choices, paid prices, purchase history, stale prices and external link requests can reveal preferences

cache_operations.data: Owned items, ownership history and personal dashboard aggregates
cache_operations.allowed_location: Request memory and current authorized render only; HTTP no-store
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + principal/scope + collection version
cache_operations.scope_binding: Current owner/authorized records; aggregate only after object filtering
cache_operations.lifetime: Current request/render only; no numeric TTL
cache_operations.invalidation_trigger: Collection mutation, membership/scope change, logout or expiry
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Clear detail and aggregate renders; reject pending writes under stale session
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Unavailable offline; no offline mutation queue
cache_operations.security_risk: Shared dashboards/counts can disclose ownership or another user collection

cache_operations.data: Authorized original or separately approved derivative bytes
cache_operations.allowed_location: Bounded request buffer and current authorized display only; HTTP no-store; no CDN/public bucket
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + principal/scope + asset hash/binding + operation/audience + rights/lineage versions
cache_operations.scope_binding: Exact asset and audience; display is distinct from acquire/transform/redistribute/cache
cache_operations.lifetime: Current authorized delivery/render only; no numeric TTL
cache_operations.invalidation_trigger: Asset binding/hash, parent rights, expiry, revocation, session or audience change
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Check before read and final delivery; cancel outstanding reads best effort; bytes already delivered cannot be erased
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Unavailable offline; generic unlicensed placeholder shell icon only
cache_operations.security_risk: Public URLs, content hashes, stale blob URLs or signed links may expose restricted assets

cache_operations.data: Allow/deny facts, expiry, membership and selected-field grants
cache_operations.allowed_location: Fresh authorization reads plus request-local checks; no reusable allow decision
cache_operations.cache_key: No reusable cache; request + principal/scope + action/audience + exact rights, review, membership and lineage versions
cache_operations.scope_binding: Exact operation; source grants and application permissions both required
cache_operations.lifetime: Current operation only; recheck after processing and before each next operation
cache_operations.invalidation_trigger: Any grant/member/review/dependency change, deadline or revocation
cache_operations.revocation_behavior: Fail closed; no stale-while-revalidate or background refresh that permits use
cache_operations.offline_behavior: Deny operational use offline; absence of current proof is Unavailable
cache_operations.security_risk: Cached allow decisions can survive revocation and wrongly authorize counts, scores or bytes

security_tests.name: Forged browser identity
security_tests.scenario: Forge user UUID, claimed role, scope header and principal DTO while holding another session.
security_tests.acceptance: Service ignores client identity claims; no principal lease or restricted lookup for forged subject.

security_tests.name: Admin/BYPASSRLS and origin
security_tests.scenario: Try superuser, BYPASSRLS, owner membership, direct excessive ACL and initially-admin impersonated connection.
security_tests.acceptance: Lease rejected before object access, even if identity equality holds after impersonation.

security_tests.name: Cross-user object access
security_tests.scenario: Use valid private perfume, buying-source, collection and asset IDs owned by another principal.
security_tests.acceptance: Uniform private Unavailable; no object fields, identifiers, counts or paths disclosed.

security_tests.name: Role/GUC substitution
security_tests.scenario: Change SET ROLE, custom GUC, request header or claimed auth_subject instead of genuine LOGIN.
security_tests.acceptance: No identity substitution accepted; session_user contract and equality gate remain intact.

security_tests.name: Stale membership
security_tests.scenario: Revoke a shared membership between operations and while a response is prepared.
security_tests.acceptance: Fresh next operation denies; final check discards unpublished response and clears stale UI state.

security_tests.name: Revoked/expired source rights
security_tests.scenario: Revoke grant or cross review deadline after lookup but before projection/scoring.
security_tests.acceptance: No new counts, score publication or field display from stale permission; no cached allow fallback.

security_tests.name: Unauthorized media and lineage
security_tests.scenario: Deny acquire/display/cache/transform/redistribution independently, including a parent derivative grant.
security_tests.acceptance: No reader callback before authorization; final binding/right change aborts publication; no storage key exposed.

security_tests.name: Pool reuse and cancellation
security_tests.scenario: Interleave owner A and owner B, timeout, exception, rollback and logout on leased connections.
security_tests.acceptance: No cross-principal connection, transaction, prepared state, result buffer or snapshot reuse; suspect lease discarded.

security_tests.name: Public/private relationship leak
security_tests.scenario: Request public entity with private observations, seller rows, collection overlay or media.
security_tests.acceptance: Public entity does not widen related records; projection omits unauthorized fields before aggregates.

security_tests.name: Existence/error/timing leakage
security_tests.scenario: Compare nonexistent, hidden, expired, revoked and unauthorized private IDs and deliberate parser failures.
security_tests.acceptance: Uniform externally observable error shape/class, no restricted IDs/counts/paths; assess timing statistically before acceptance, without claiming perfect constant time.

security_tests.name: Persistent/shared cache leakage
security_tests.scenario: Inspect HTTP/framework/client caches, service workers, IndexedDB, localStorage, SSR payloads and log exports after logout and user switch.
security_tests.acceptance: Operational data is no-store/request-local only; no persistent/shared private entry or hidden query history.

security_tests.name: Rights/selection race and restore
security_tests.scenario: Change selected claim, hold, asset binding or rights while work runs; restore an old backup.
security_tests.acceptance: Revalidate current dependency versions; reject stale publication; restored permission never reactivates withdrawn use automatically.

security_tests.name: Private mutation authorization
security_tests.scenario: Forge collection/status/review writes; retry stale or duplicate write intent.
security_tests.acceptance: Validate exact action, object, version/replay and user scope; no order placement or generic admin operation.

security_tests.name: Logout/offline behavior
security_tests.scenario: Expire/logout session during display, then disconnect and reopen routes.
security_tests.acceptance: New operation denied, pending results discarded, local controlled renders cleared; no stale offline results, automatic replay or promise of remote erasure.
